app.title: Name That Thing
app.tagline: You've seen it. But do you know its name?
app.lead: Guess the names of the little parts of everyday things.

mode.heading: Choose how to play
mode.normal.name: Classic
mode.normal.rule: Relaxed play: learn from each explanation. No time pressure.
mode.time10.name: 10-Question Time Attack
mode.time10.rule: How fast can you answer 10 questions? Wrong answers do not stop you.
mode.time30.name: 30-Question Time Attack
mode.time30.rule: How fast can you answer 30 questions? Tests focus and speed as well as knowledge.
mode.survival.name: 100-Question Survival
mode.survival.rule: One wrong answer ends the game. Answer all 100 correctly to clear it.
mode.survival.feature: Hard: one mistake and it is over
mode.timeRule: The clock only runs while a question waits for your answer. Reading explanations and image loading are not counted. Best times count plays with 70% or more correct.
mode.unavailable: This mode needs at least {need} questions (currently {have}).
mode.leaveConfirm: Leave this game and go back? This play will not be recorded.
